CPython fixes the preferred encoding at interpreter start and both the worker image (python slim base, PEP 538 coercion to C.UTF-8) and every child worker_home spawns (LANG C.UTF-8) run UTF-8, so the default encoding names the same codec as the explicit utf-8; no test can tell them apart without restarting the interpreter under another locale.
